canonical_project: Magyar Telekom Cloud & DataCenter Budapest / Dataplex
notes: Magyar Telekom's wholesale hosting page lists T-Systems Cloud & DataCenter at 1087 Budapest, Asztalos Sandor u. 13. Telekom Wholesale describes the Budapest facility as one of the region's highest-tech data centers; third-party listings identify it as Dataplex, established in 1999 with 8,800 sqm technical space. Baxtel market summary reports Dataplex as Hungary's largest data center with 8 MW.
